text.description_html:
Fusion PH-C6, River Rock Collection Oval Toilet Tissue Holder

Available in either medium bronze or dark bronze, the Oval Mount Toilet Tissue Holder is a stunning example of the beauty of simplicity. It is a little bit silly to describe a toilet paper holder as being beautiful, but the best designers know that the littlest details are what really make a room. The oval mount is not unlike the texture, shape, and color of the river rocks for which this toilet paper holder is named. It is easy to install and comes packaged with all the necessary hardware.

Also Available Matching: Fusion TB-C6 River Rock Towel Bar, Fusion TR-C6 River Rock Towel Ring, and Fusion RH-C6 River Rock Robe Hook

Features and Specifications of the Fusion Oval Wall Mounted Toilet Paper Holder:

  • Mount Width: 3"
  • Mount Length: 4-1/2"
  • Reversible to hang in either direction.
  • Comes packaged with mounting hardware.

Sold Individually
